result.summary: The screen is largely coherent, but there is a spelling error in the search placeholder and an inconsistent favorite-button style between the two 'Popular right now' cards. A few minor styling inconsistencies also appear in the carousel thumbnails.

issues.description: The search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the Tokumaru Ramen card has a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below has a dark/near-black circular button with a white heart. This looks like a broken or unthemed state and the dark button has poor contrast against the dark image.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button treatment (e.g. semi-transparent white circle with dark outline heart) on all cards, and reserve a filled/colored heart only for the active 'favorited' state.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a light grey background while the neighbouring thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven and the duration badge lower-contrast.
issues.suggestion: Normalise thumbnail treatment (consistent image aspect/backdrop or a subtle gradient overlay) so badges keep consistent contrast across all cards.

issues.description: Metadata text such as '€0.90 delivery' and the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' line uses light grey on white, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text colour to meet at least 4.5:1 contrast against the white background.
